full_judgment: 2. The appellants as plaintiffs filed Other Suit No. 184 of 1994 for declaration of title and Khas possession by evicting the defendants on removing obstructions. The defendants appeared and filed written statement opposing the claim of the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs thereafter filed an application under Order VI, rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the plaint by incorporating a prayer for partition as an alternative to the prayer for eviction and also for addition of two persons as defendants.
